mapper.insert: insert into task (tenant_id, project_id, title, description, status, priority, assignee_user_id, created_by_user_id) values (#{tenantId},#{projectId},#{title},#{description},#{status},#{priority},#{assigneeUserId},#{createdByUserId})
mapper.select: select task_id,tenant_id,project_id,title,description,status,priority,assignee_user_id,created_by_user_id from task where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and project_id=#{projectId} order by task_id desc
select count(1) from project where project_id=#{projectId} and tenant_id=#{tenantId} and status=0
mapper.update: update task set status=#{status}, update_time=current_timestamp, version=version+1 where task_id=#{taskId} and tenant_id=#{tenantId}
